method: DPR1 fixedTime3.2 presentation fixtures; raw rule-resolved multi/burst casts. No timing claims from screenshots.

ui.focusText: Burn — Scald. Lose 12 HP per stack at round end, bypassing shields. Steep removes one stack when healing. Stacks 5/5. 3 rounds remaining.
ui.overflowText:
Daze — Drowsy. Committed enemy signature becomes a half-power basic. Every actor still takes its turn. Stacks 1/1. 1 rounds remaining.
Daze — Hush. Enemy heal, summon or shield action becomes a basic. Cat energy skills cost 1 more. Stacks 1/1. 2 rounds remaining.
Shred — Brittle sugar. Each direct hit removes an extra 15 shield per stack before damage. Stacks 3/3. 2 rounds remaining.
Warm — Cozy. Reduce direct damage by 10% per stack. Does not reduce scald. Stacks 3/3. 2 rounds remaining.
Regen — Steep. Heal 18 HP per stack at round end and remove one Scald stack. Stacks 3/3. 3 rounds remaining.
Crumb — Crumb trail. Stores 24 damage per stack for a detonation. Detonation consumes all stacks. Stacks 4/4. 3 rounds remaining.
Glaze — Glaze. Gain 20 shield per stack when starting a turn, capped at 60% maximum HP. Stacks 2/2. 2 rounds remaining.
Shelter — Shelter. Hostile single-target intents prefer this actor while alive. Row-wide attacks remain row-wide. Stacks 1/1. 2 rounds remaining.
Riposte — Saucer riposte. Each direct hostile hit returns 16 damage per stack. Reflections cannot trigger reflections. Stacks 2/2. 2 rounds remaining.
Link — Apron link. The living source takes 30% of direct HP damage to the linked ally. Shared damage does not chain. Stacks 1/1. 3 rounds remaining.
Sprout — Second sprout. Consume to survive a fatal hit at 25% HP, once per battle per actor. Stacks 1/1. 3 rounds remaining.
Decoy — Yarn decoy. Absorbs the next direct hit entirely, then disappears. Scald passes through. Stacks 1/1. 2 rounds remaining.
